name: Tone (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tone town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with two rounded ends.
history: Municipal flag of Tone, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 January 1965.

features.role: Tone town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with two rounded ends
